{{Top|leg}}
'''Tan''' was a [[H'kig]] glyph that represented one of the mystical ideals of the peaceful religion. The glyph represented the "conscious essence." Tan was considered to be secular enough to be written out in full, unlike some of the other glyphs such as [[Jeh]], [[Peh]], and [[Teh]]. The glyph was used in the creation of the name for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[J't'p'tan]].<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
